newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-BALLESTEROS TO START HAMBURG TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-BALLESTEROS TO START HAMBURG TOURNAMENT.

text.p: European Ryder Cup captain Seve Ballesteros will start this week's Tournament Players Championship in Hamburg despite a recurring back injury.
Ballesteros, who withdrew from this weekend's British PGA Championship at Wentworth before the start of the second round, said on Monday he was considering surgery to correct the injury.
"Despite his injury I can confirm Seve intends playing the German tournament," his agent Roddy Carr said.

Dropping out of the PGA had already cost the 40-year-old Spaniard the chance of a lucrative haul of Ryder Cup points in his bid to be the playing captain in the September match against the Americans at Valderrama.
He is currently 29th on the list, mainly as a result of his form late last year. This year he has missed the halfway cut in six of his eight tournaments.
